device.description: The block device path containing the ext2/3/4 filesystem to process.

fill_value.description: Octet value (0-255) to fill unallocated blocks with. 0 is standard zeroing; 255 (0xFF) may help SSDs.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output to show number of modified/free blocks.

dry_run.description: If true, perform a dry run and do not modify the file-system.
